INSERT INTO yglue_project_endpoint (project_id, endpoint_type, component_type, method, path, name, description, config_json, create_by, update_by, del_flag) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{endpointType}, #{componentType}, #{method}, #{path}, #{name}, #{description}, #{configJson}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{delFlag}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), config_json = VALUES(config_json), component_type = VALUES(component_type), del_flag = VALUES(del_flag), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW()

mapper.update: UPDATE yglue_project_endpoint SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, config_json = #{configJson}, component_type = #{componentType}, del_flag = #{delFlag}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
